team_id.description: Team (organization) id, required on every call when the user belongs to more than one team; get_me lists them.

marked.description: True to mark it read, false to mark it unread.

create_time_tracking_report.title: Run a time tracking report
create_time_tracking_report.description: Generate a time tracking report: every time entry in a date range, optionally narrowed to projects, users, lists or tags. Results come 50 per page.

page.description: Page number; results come 50 per page.

team_id.description: Team (organization) id, required on every call when the user belongs to more than one team; get_me lists them.

start_date.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative value: last_month, last_week, yesterday, today, this_week, this_month.

stages.description: Only cards in lists with these names.

output.description: Time entries: id, created_at, logged_date, notbillable, tracked (minutes), user_id, project_id, card_id, desc.

get_me.title: Get the current user
get_me.description: Read the user the API token belongs to: id, name, email, avatar and the teams they are part of. The team ids are what `team_id` takes on other calls.

output.description: The current user, including their teams.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List every user in the team, with id, email and name.

team_id.description: Team (organization) id, required on every call when the user belongs to more than one team; get_me lists them.
